notes.title: Universal Update
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the Space Dragon Universal Update for SteamVR!

This update brings Space Dragon on Steam inline with the Quest and Pico ports, adding all of the additional game content from those versions. 

[list]
[*] A major overall performance boost and visual updates
[*] More bullet hell. MORE!
[*] New weapons for the AI enemies, including guided missiles, tracking lasers, and more
[*] New level events and points of interest!
[*] Additional level content leading up to the bosses
[*] Updated boss fights!
[*] New story content via Intercepted transmissions from the AI core
[*] Localization added for French, Spanish, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, & Traditional Chinese
[/list]

The update is live NOW! Check it out and remember to drop a review to let us know what you think!

notes.title: PRESS RELEASE: YOUR ARMS ARE DRAGONS. IN SPACE.
notes.content:
General Info for SPACE DRAGON
Developer and Publisher: 3lb Games 
Release Date: 6 December 2017
Genre: Arcade, Shooter
Website: http://www.3lbgames.com
Price: $14.99 (with a limited 40% launch discount!)
Age Rating: E for Everyone

Game Description 
YOUR ARMS ARE DRAGONS. IN SPACE.
Take control of a pair of young space dragons on a VR quest for revenge! Destroy planets! Use the dragons’ devastating firepower to annihilate robotic armadas, eradicate unique bosses, and scour star systems as you carve your way through the galaxy. And if flying dragons through a virtual reality star system sounds like a recipe for nausea, no worry! Our unique move-and-warp system mitigates motion sickness, letting you rocket through the stars with glee.
Space Dragon is a VR game from 3lb Games LLC, releasing from Early Access on November 30. The full release adds even more dragony goodness - including boss fights, brand-new epic music from Robin Moulder, and significant graphics and UI updates. Experience the thrill of commanding space dragons and destroying every planet you see!

Space Dragon will be released on Steam for $14.99 on December 6.
